[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Sarah was born after 1850. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1171|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Bradley-21461|Sarah Bradley]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1171]] is assessed at 97% (proved). The held 1894 Cayuga biography explicitly calls Sarah Jane the daughter born to Robert and his second wife Sarah Bradley. The spouse sequence distinguishes her from his first-wife children.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the original 1894 biography and Sarah Jane’s marriage entry.
